title: What a software architect is and where their authority comes from

videos.script: A company gives someone the title of architect. What has it actually given them? {{title}} This lesson describes the job in three verbs. The architect decides, documents and answers for the structural choices. {{verbs}} We follow Renata through her first week. She meets the CTO, collects nine open questions that nobody owns, and reads the system rather than its documents. On her fourth day she is asked to decide something, and she chooses not to. {{week}} Then authority. A title lets you decide. It does not make anyone follow the decision. Most of the authority that works is earned, team by team. {{authority}} You will meet the advice process, where anyone may make an architectural decision, after asking the people it affects. {{advice}} Last, accountability. A decision Renata made in ten minutes goes wrong, and two drivers are paid twice. {{incident}} How she answers for it is the point of this lesson, and it is not the same as taking the blame. So is the question underneath it. Who should have decided, and how? {{spectrum}}
